description: Ubicazione degli impianti per la telefonia mobile nel Comune di Rimini is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data-sit-rimini.opendata.arcgis.com. Map with location of mobile telephony systems in the Municipality of Rimini. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Location of mobile telephony systems in the Municipality of Rimini" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
